title: 부동산에서 집 계약 협의하기: 월세를 낮출 수 있는지 물어봐요
objective: Use -는지 to ask an agent to check lease terms.
summary: A tenant talks with an agent about rent and fees.
setting: A real estate office (부동산). A customer came back the day after seeing a studio apartment (오피스텔) and is talking about the lease terms with the agent.

task.title: Practice the lease conversation
task.line: Use the words and the -는지 pattern from the dialogue to complete each item.

words.meaning: a lease where you pay one large deposit and no monthly rent
words.exampleMeaning: It's a jeonse lease, so I don't pay rent every month.

words.meaning: monthly rent (a lease with a smaller deposit plus rent each month)
words.exampleMeaning: I send the monthly rent to the owner on the 25th of every month.

words.meaning: security deposit (you get it back when you move out)
words.exampleMeaning: I got my deposit back when I moved out.

words.meaning: maintenance fee (building costs paid apart from rent)
words.example: 겨울에는 난방 때문에 관리비가 많이 나와요.
words.exampleMeaning: In winter the maintenance fee is high because of heating.

words.example: 경기가 안 좋아서 집주인이 월세를 조금 낮췄어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The economy is bad, so the owner lowered the rent a little.

words.example: 이 금액에 수도 요금도 포함돼 있어요?
words.exampleMeaning: Is the water bill included in this amount too?

dialogue.korean: 안녕하세요. 어제 본 오피스텔 말인데요, 전세로도 계약할 수 있는지 궁금해서요.
dialogue.meaning: Hello. It's about the studio I saw yesterday. I was wondering if I can also rent it on jeonse.

dialogue.korean: 아쉽지만 집주인께서 월세만 원하세요. 보증금 1,000만 원에 월세 70만 원이에요.
dialogue.meaning: Sorry, but the owner only wants monthly rent. It's a 10 million won deposit and 700,000 won a month.

dialogue.korean: 월세가 좀 부담되네요. 보증금을 더 내면 월세를 낮춰 주실 수 있는지 여쭤봐 주시겠어요?
dialogue.meaning: The monthly rent is a bit much for me. Could you ask the owner if they'd lower the rent if I pay a bigger deposit?

dialogue.korean: 잠깐만요, 지금 전화해 볼게요. … 보증금을 3,000만 원으로 올리면 월세를 60만 원으로 해 주시겠대요.
dialogue.meaning: One moment, I'll call now. … The owner says if you raise the deposit to 30 million won, they'll make the rent 600,000 won.

dialogue.korean: 그럼 그렇게 할게요. 관리비는 얼마나 나와요?
dialogue.meaning: Then I'll do that. How much does the maintenance fee come to?

dialogue.korean: 한 달에 10만 원쯤 나와요. 인터넷은 포함이 안 돼서 따로 신청하셔야 해요.
dialogue.meaning: It's about 100,000 won a month. Internet isn't included, so you need to sign up for it separately.

dialogue.korean: 알겠습니다. 그리고 다음 달 15일에 입주할 수 있는지도 확인해 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: I see. Also, please check if I can move in on the 15th of next month.

dialogue.korean: 지금 사는 분이 10일에 나가시니까 괜찮아요. 계약은 언제 하시겠어요?
dialogue.meaning: The current tenant is moving out on the 10th, so that's fine. When would you like to sign the contract?

exercises: Fill in the blank with a word from the word list: 월세 말고 엘리베이터와 청소 비용으로 매달 ____를 따로 내요.
Join the two sentences with -는지: ① 입주할 수 있어요? + 확인해 주세요. ② 반려동물을 키워도 돼요? + 집주인에게 물어봐 주세요.
Answer in Korean based on the dialogue: 손님은 보증금과 월세를 얼마로 하기로 했어요?
Mark O (true) or X (false) based on the dialogue: ① 손님은 처음에 전세로 계약할 수 있는지 물어봤어요. ② 관리비에 인터넷 요금이 포함돼 있어요. ③ 손님은 다음 달 10일에 입주해요.
answers: ① 입주할 수 있는지 확인해 주세요. ② 반려동물을 키워도 되는지 집주인에게 물어봐 주세요.
보증금 3,000만 원에 월세 60만 원으로 하기로 했어요.
① O ② X ③ X
